Name: Sits' Cave Farm
Author: SkeletalSits
Description:
[size=5][b][color=#ff0000]Delete Config File if updating to the newest Version![/color][/b][u][b][color=#ff0000]
[/color][/b]
Requires Content Patcher and Config Menu!

[/u][/size]This is the second version of my first little Stardew mapping project!
I'd been toying with the idea of an underground farm for a while, and while my first attempt was "okay" (see my other mod in my profile to see what I mean), I was overall disappointed with the end result, there were issues and the layout wasn't great.

I wanted to create something that was unique, with it's own kind of playstyle to breathe a bit of life into the game for me again.
So that's where this map comes in!


[size=4][u]Features[/u][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]The Cave farm is hot and humid, and supports a wide variety of crops! (It acts like a greenhouse)[/size]
[*][size=3]The Cave farm is quite dark, while not quite enough to be unbearable, it's still enough that you'll want to craft light sources eventually so you can see better.[/size]
[*][size=3]To offset the massive boost that an early greenhouse gives you there is also a lack of tillable land, you're heavily restricted in the area you can plant your crops in.[/size]
[*][size=3]Trees can grow anywhere in the cave and you start with a single mushroom tree.[/size]
[*][size=3]The Elevator takes you to the surface, where you have a small forested crossroads. [/size][b][color=#ff0000][size=4](Turn this off in the config if you're not using the map!!)[/size][/color][/b]
[/list]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Planned Features[/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]A custom "Inverted" farm cave with access to sunlight and more tillable land, at the cost of normal seasonal growth[/size]
[/list][/color]
